jobs.title: Team Lead Non-Financial Risk and Internal Controls
jobs.description: N26 is hiring a Team Lead to manage a team of four specialists within Non-Financial Risk Management, owning risk and control assessments, risk appetite frameworks, and enterprise-wide reporting to leadership.
jobs.coverLetterDraft:
Dear N26 Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Team Lead, Non-Financial Risk and Internal Controls role. As Compliance Operations Manager at Pliant, I lead end-to-end KYC due diligence for corporate clients while driving AI-driven automation of compliance workflows as part of an internal AI team — experience that translates directly to designing and maintaining internal control systems and risk appetite frameworks at N26.

Earlier, at Moonfare I co-led an ongoing due-diligence review project and helped shape automation improvements with cross-functional stakeholders, and at J.P. Morgan Chase I conducted due diligence across Corporate, Financial Institution, and Publicly Traded Company risk tiers. Across eight years in KYC, AML, and financial operations, I've built the analytical rigor, escalation management, and stakeholder communication this role demands, plus the four-eyes discipline and quality-review mindset needed to manage a specialist team's output.

I hold a Master's in Finance and Accounting and am progressing toward German B2, and I'm based in Berlin and ready to lead N26's Non-Financial Risk function forward.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

expected: How would you design a Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) framework for a new product line at N26?
Describe a time you managed a team through a high-pressure regulatory audit or examination.
How do you balance risk appetite frameworks with business growth priorities?
Walk us through how you would onboard and mentor a team of four specialists with varying experience levels.
What's your approach to reporting risk metrics to senior leadership in a way that drives action?
How have you used automation or AI to improve compliance or risk workflows in a previous role?
toAsk: How is the Non-Financial Risk team's roadmap currently balanced between regulatory-driven priorities and proactive process improvement?
What does success look like for this Team Lead role in the first six months?
How does the team collaborate with N26's AFC and Banking Compliance functions day to day?

jobs.title: Head of Compliance & MLRO - Germany
jobs.description: Wise is hiring a Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee compliance with German and EEA AML/CTF regulations, act as primary regulatory contact, and lead compliance policy, risk frameworks, and reporting for the German entity.
jobs.coverLetterDraft:
Dear Wise Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Head of Compliance & MLRO - Germany role. With 8+ years in KYC, AML, and financial operations — most recently as Compliance Operations Manager at Pliant, where I lead end-to-end KYC due diligence for corporate clients and drive AI-driven automation of compliance workflows — I bring the regulatory depth and process-improvement mindset this MLRO mandate requires.

At Moonfare, I co-led the firm's ongoing due-diligence review project and worked with cross-functional stakeholders on automation improvements; at J.P. Morgan Chase, I conducted due diligence across Corporate, Financial Institution, and Publicly Traded Company risk tiers; and at PwC I delivered internal AML/KYC training and built AML risk ratings for individuals and legal entities. This combination of regulatory-relationship experience, policy development, and training delivery maps closely to the responsibilities of a German MLRO.

I hold a Master's in Finance and Accounting, am fluent in English, and am currently at German B1 progressing to B2 — actively building toward full fluency for this Berlin-based role.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

expected: How would you structure Wise's AML/CTF risk assessment for the German entity given its cross-border payment flows?
Describe your experience acting as the primary point of contact with a financial regulator.
How do you prioritize competing regulatory deadlines across multiple jurisdictions?
What's your approach to designing and delivering AML/compliance training programs at scale?
Tell us about a time you identified a compliance gap and drove the policy change to close it.
How would you approach conducting regulatory liaison work in German while you continue building fluency?
toAsk: What is the current regulatory relationship status with BaFin, and what are the near-term priorities?
How does the Germany compliance function coordinate with Wise's global compliance and legal teams?
What support or budget is available for building out the compliance team under this role?

[Your Name]

expected: How would you scale a compliance operations team to handle Trade Republic's customer growth across 18 countries?

jobs.title: KYC Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Trade Republic is hiring a KYC Manager to perform high-level KYC screening and reviews, guide junior team members through escalations, and ensure adherence to regulatory and partnership requirements.
jobs.coverLetterDraft:
Dear Trade Republic Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the KYC Manager role. As Compliance Operations Manager at Pliant, I lead end-to-end KYC due diligence for corporate clients and drive AI-driven automation of compliance workflows — direct preparation for owning high-level KYC screening and reviews at Trade Republic's scale.

Previously, as KYC Associate at Moonfare I co-led the firm's ongoing due-diligence review project and guided institutional clients through KYC/AML documentation; as KYC Analyst at J.P. Morgan Chase I conducted due diligence across Corporate, Financial Institution, and Publicly Traded Company risk tiers; and as AML Analyst at PwC I built KYC profiles and AML risk ratings while delivering internal AML/KYC training. This gives me both the technical depth and the mentoring instinct to guide junior team members through escalations and calibrate case quality.

I hold a Master's in Finance and Accounting, am fluent in English, and speak German at B1 progressing to B2 — matching the language profile this role requires.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

expected: Walk us through how you'd handle an escalation from a junior analyst on a complex UBO structure.
How do you ensure consistency in KYC decisioning across a team performing high volumes of reviews?
Describe your experience with name-list or sanctions screening tools and false-positive management.
How do you balance regulatory, payment-network, and partnership requirements when they conflict?
Tell us about a time you improved a KYC process for speed without sacrificing quality.
How would you support a team of junior KYC analysts through complex escalations, given the role's German B1+ requirement?
toAsk: What's the average case volume and risk-tiering mix this KYC Manager role would oversee?
How does this role interact with Trade Republic's Head of Compliance Operations and AFC functions?
What tools or automation does Trade Republic use for KYC screening today, and are there plans to expand them?
